review_candidates.title: Support Engineer I
review_candidates.description: About you: You are a technically minded problem-solver who enjoys hands-on engineering work and making complex systems run smoothly. You thrive on supporting users of cutting-edge prototypes, digging into issues, and ensuring instruments operate at peak performance. You’re comfortable troubleshooting across hardware and software, documenting findings clearly, and collaborating with development teams to turn feedback into improvements. You’re organized, curious, and energized by being the person who keeps R&D moving in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. What you'll do: Log, track, and triage bugs, defects, and issues reported by users of prototype instruments. Conduct root cause analysis and troubleshoot hardware, firmware, and software issues on prototype systems. Perform routine maintenance, repairs, and calibrations to keep prototypes operational and reliable. Run routine quality control checks to ensure instruments meet performance and reliability standards. Provide training and responsive support to internal users of our prototype devices, answering technical questions and guiding best practices. Document findings from troubleshooting and repair activities and communicate clear summaries and recommendations to the development team. Work closely with engineering teams to implement solutions and improvements based on user feedback and failure trends. Contribute to continuous improvement of prototypes through hands-on testing, feedback loops, and iterative fixes. Help design and implement infrastructure solutions that maintain a safe, organized, and streamlined workspace. What you'll need: Bachelor’s degree in Applied Physics, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with technical work, including troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of electromechanical systems. Strong organizational skills for tracking issues, managing tickets, and supporting quality control activities. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally. Familiarity with basic hardware and software testing tools, repair tools, and diagnostic equipment. Basic knowledge of quality control and reliability testing concepts. Comfort with CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) to review designs and understand mechanical interfaces. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, supporting both engineers and end users. Bonus points for: Experience with structured root cause analysis and troubleshooting of electromechanical or mechatronic systems. Familiarity with bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira) and quality management software. Basic understanding of regulatory environments such as FDA, ISO standards, or GMP guidelines. Basic programming skills for test automation or troubleshooting (e.g., Python, C/C++). Prior experience in a startup, R&D lab, or prototype-heavy environment. An appreciation for puns and contributing to a supportive, curious team culture. Why Join us? At VitalBio you will: Be the frontline support for the instruments that power our diagnostic platform—keeping R&D teams unblocked and prototypes performing at their best. You’ll gain deep exposure to our technology across mechanics, electronics, and software, while working closely with the engineers who design them. As we iterate quickly from concept to clinical-ready systems, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your technical skills, shape support processes, and see your work directly enable breakthroughs in patient care. The compensation range for this role is $60,000 - $70,000 CAD. Compensation will be determined based on the individual’s demonstrated experience, education, training, relevant certifications or licensure, and other applicable business and organizational factors. This role is a current, onsite vacancy. About Vital Bio Vital is revolutionizing point-of-care diagnostics with our VitalOne platform, delivering real-time care wherever patients are. Our mission is to democratize health technology, making healthcare more accessible and proactive. Our global team of experts spans chemistry, software, engineering, and microfluidics. We thrive on change, operate on trust, and value diverse perspectives. Our growth-minded culture empowers front-line decision-making and fosters impactful work. We seek tenacious, bold individuals ready to transform healthcare. At Vital, your talent will make a difference as we work to ensure everyone has access to care when and where they need it. Vital Biosciences Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We are therefore happy to accommodate any individual needs in keeping with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation in order to participate in our hiring process, please contact us to make your needs known in advance As part of our recruitment process, we may use automated or AI-supported tools to assist with application review and screening. These tools are used to support, not replace, human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our hiring team.

The position combines hands-on Go development with database engineering, distributed systems, performance optimization, and production support. You’ll own features end to end, contributing from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You’ll work closely with product, design, platform, and QA colleagues to solve real-world enterprise challenges. It’s an opportunity to contribute to a modern cloud-native platform while tackling technically demanding problems at meaningful scale. Design and implement database migrations using established patterns for schema compatibility, reliability, and safe upgrades. Develop observability, reporting, and audit capabilities that give administrators clear visibility into their deployments and system activity. Build and maintain security-focused backend features in accordance with established enterprise security practices. Troubleshoot and resolve backend issues reported by platform operators and enterprise administrators. Document technical solutions and implementation decisions clearly so that code and features remain maintainable for reviewers and future engineers. Professional experience developing and shipping production software with Go. Solid understanding of Go's concurrency model, including goroutines, channels, and the sync package. Comfortable working with SQL, relational databases, schema changes, and database migrations. Strong debugging and analytical skills, with persistence in investigating complex technical problems and good judgment about when to escalate. Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to surface blockers, risks, and uncertainty early. Self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of technically challenging work. Experience with observability, audit, or security capabilities in an enterprise software environment is an advantage. Experience investigating performance under real-world or production-like workloads, including race conditions, is a plus. Familiarity with major cloud providers, Kubernetes, and container orchestration is desirable. Experience building or operating distributed systems at meaningful scale is beneficial. Curiosity about modern developer tooling and emerging approaches to software development. Familiarity with technologies such as PostgreSQL, gRPC, Prometheus, Grafana, and GitHub Actions is an advantage. Benefits Opportunity to work on a modern cloud-native platform serving enterprise customers. Hands-on exposure to Go, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, gRPC, observability tooling, and distributed systems.
